name: Benchmark Denominator Error
applicable_contexts: area or simple intensity metric at risk of misuse
trigger_conditions: benchmark or peer comparison under consideration
throughput, service level, occupancy or process duty unresolved
simple denominator likely to misstate performance
anti_triggers: simple denominator is justified by the asset family and duty
physical_basis: A denominator is only valid if it tracks the physical and operational burden that actually drives energy and cost.
operational_basis: Area, occupancy or throughput shortcuts can punish assets for doing the work that gives them value.
financial_mechanism: Wrong denominators distort peer valuation, retrofit framing and underwriting logic.
typical_false_assumption: Any benchmark is better than no benchmark.
hypothesis: The current benchmark denominator may be conceptually invalid for this asset until the dominant burden is normalized.
rival_hypotheses: the chosen denominator is already fair
benchmark pressure is minor or clearly bounded
the asset family has a stable valid denominator
falsification_conditions: chosen denominator matches the dominant burden
allowed_claim_language: The current benchmark denominator may be invalid until the dominant burden is normalized.
prohibited_claim_language: The benchmark proves this asset is inefficient.
stop_conditions: dominant denominator is bounded enough for fair comparison
escalation_conditions: operator evidence required when public comparability dimensions remain missing
example_outputs: Area may be the wrong denominator.
tests: warehouse and manufacturing bundles should admit this when simple intensity framing remains unnormalized
pattern must remain bounded at L2
